Robey’s Atlas of Indigenous North America

Install Indigenous North America

The free research directory appears on your home screen as Indigenous North America.

iPhone or iPad

  1. Open the Atlas in Safari.
  2. Tap Share. In some Safari layouts, open the page menu or More first.
  3. Choose Add to Home Screen. If it’s missing, check Edit Actions or View More in the share menu.
  4. Turn on Open as Web App if shown, then tap Add.

Android

  1. Open the Atlas in Chrome.
  2. Tap the ⋮ menu and choose Install and create shortcut, then Install. Some versions show Install app or Add to Home screen directly.
  3. Confirm the installation to add the Atlas to your phone.

On a computer

In Chrome or Edge, look for the install icon in the address bar or the install option in the browser menu. In Safari on a Mac, choose File → Add to Dock when available.

Reading offline

Recently visited Atlas pages may be available offline on this device. External archives, PDFs and other linked sources need an internet connection. Device storage can be cleared.
